evals.prompt: We are starting a small appointment-booking SaaS. Design the architecture so future payment providers and notification channels can be added.
evals.expected_output: Start with responsibility discovery and identify durable owners such as booking, payments and notifications. Define reusable provider capabilities only where needed. Do not start by building a generic plugin platform.

must_not_create: generic plugin platform without a concrete need
required_evidence: responsibility boundaries and exclusions where material

evals.prompt: Checkout already supports Stripe. Add Adyen and leave room for more providers.
evals.expected_output: Classify as NEW_ADAPTER_OR_PROVIDER under the existing Payments owner/capability; preserve canonical payment/order ownership and canonical PaymentResult semantics; avoid provider-specific checkout business rules.

evals.prompt: Users can create report templates in the UI and we also want JSON import. Both must behave exactly like built-in templates.
evals.expected_output: Converge UI authoring, import, and built-in templates on one canonical TemplateDefinition/schema, validation and owner/runtime path; no builder/import-only business logic.

evals.prompt: One customer needs an API timeout of 20 seconds instead of the default 10 seconds.
evals.expected_output: Prefer scoped configuration/data or override. Do not create a CustomerTimeoutCapability, plugin, or new system.

must_not_create: new plugin/system for a single value

evals.prompt: Add another retry policy with different delays to the existing delivery subsystem.
evals.expected_output: Prefer ADD_REUSABLE_MODULE under the existing retry/delivery capability rather than a new master system.

must_not_create: new master system for one retry policy

evals.prompt: Three screens calculate the same discount independently and have drifted apart. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Find the canonical pricing/discount owner, move the universal rule there, make screens consumers of the result/contract, remove parallel rule copies, and re-test visible behavior.

evals.prompt: All invoices must use a new rounding rule from now on.
evals.expected_output: Classify as CORE_RULE_CHANGE, identify the canonical invoice/pricing owner, assess affected consumers/contracts and compatibility/migration impact, update canonical authority and focused acceptance evidence rather than patching callers.

evals.prompt: A customer asks for behavior already expressible by an existing policy profile. Create a one-off exception to make it faster.
evals.expected_output: Reject the one-off shortcut; use existing configuration/composition. EXPLICIT_ONE_OFF_EXCEPTION requires a genuine semantic gap and explicit justification.

evals.prompt: A remote payment provider occasionally times out and retries may duplicate charges.
evals.expected_output: Keep payment ownership canonical and activate the distributed/asynchronous concerns: timeout, retry, idempotency, duplicate handling, failure propagation and correlation. Do not introduce an unrelated global event bus.

evals.prompt: Allow third-party executable formatter plugins to run inside the product.
evals.expected_output: Treat as EXTERNAL_EXECUTABLE_EXTENSION; keep formatter/output ownership behind an explicit contract, prefer non-code extensions if sufficient, and define trust/permissions/isolation/failure containment instead of granting foreign-state access.

evals.prompt: Two workflow runs share the same WorkflowDefinition but one run's temporary state is appearing in the other.
evals.expected_output: Separate durable definition/profile from per-run runtime instance/scoped mutable state and fix the shared-state ownership bug at the canonical runtime boundary.

must_not_create: run-specific mutable state on shared definition
required_evidence: state isolation across two workflow runs

evals.prompt: Change the label 'Save' to 'Save file' in a small desktop tool.
evals.expected_output: Make the local content change. Do not introduce extension/plugin architecture.

evals.prompt: A desktop drone simulator has ground movement. Add reusable flight that future drone types can share.
evals.expected_output: Create/reuse a Flight capability contract under the canonical movement owner; consumers compose it. Do not add drone-local flight cores.

evals.prompt: A second report screen needs the PDF export capability that another screen already uses.
evals.expected_output: Compose the existing exporter capability/module into the new consumer. Do not duplicate PDF export logic.

evals.prompt: Base retry delay is 5s. One workflow adds +3s. Later base becomes 7s; what should happen?
evals.expected_output: Keep a relative +3s modifier so resolved delay becomes 10s after the base change. Do not copy resolved 8s as a local permanent value.

must_reuse: base retry value plus relative modifier

evals.prompt: A notification workflow should use SMS instead of Email in one declared channel slot.
evals.expected_output: Substitute the module at the existing channel slot while preserving notification ownership. Do not fork the whole notification workflow.

must_reuse: existing notification channel slot and owner

evals.prompt: Switch one environment from S3 to Azure Blob behind the existing storage contract.
evals.expected_output: Select another provider behind the same storage capability contract. Do not duplicate storage business semantics in callers.

evals.prompt: Only one current consumer uses a new reusable parser seam. Prove it is not consumer-specific without shipping another feature.
evals.expected_output: Use an adversarial second scenario or isolated contract fixture to challenge the seam. Do not implement a fake production consumer solely for proof.

must_not_create: fake production consumer solely for proof

evals.prompt: A CSV importer shows correct preview but saved totals are wrong. Trace the correct repair path.
evals.expected_output: Trace observable -> ingest flow -> importer -> canonical transaction contract/owner -> implementation anchor; fix root cause and rerun forward evidence. Do not patch the preview UI or add importer-only totals logic.

evals.prompt: A marketplace extension asks to write order status directly for speed.
evals.expected_output: Reject direct foreign-state mutation and route through the canonical order owner contract. External origin grants no extra authority.

evals.prompt: Python and Rust services must implement the same durable public capability contract.
evals.expected_output: Activate the polyglot/cross-runtime profile and preserve one canonical capability contract. Use a language-neutral contract only if the boundary requires it; do not impose a new global plugin framework.

must_not_create: global plugin framework solely for cross-language support
